title: WHO growth standards name six motor milestones, including crawling, without ages on the overview
summary: WHO's Child Growth Standards overview names six gross motor milestones, including hands-and-knees crawling, and the overview does not print their age windows.
body: The WHO Child Growth Standards site says its charts are complemented by windows of achievement for six gross motor milestones. The six it names are sitting without support, standing with assistance, hands-and-knees crawling, walking with assistance, standing alone, and walking alone. The overview page names that list. It does not print the age window for each item. Crawling is one of the six named items. This is not a statement that every child crawls, and it is not an age. The wording is paraphrased from the WHO page.

sources.title: Child growth standards
sources.author: World Health Organization
sources.note: Paraphrase only. Supports the six named gross motor milestones and the absence of age windows on this overview page.
